match_same.name: Match the Same
match_same.teaches: matching identical objects and pictures one to one (the first step before sorting and counting)
match_same.representation: two columns of line-drawn pictures; draw a line to join each pair that is the same
match_same.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

odd_one_out.name: Which One Does Not Belong?
odd_one_out.teaches: identifying a set: objects that belong together because they share one attribute
odd_one_out.representation: a row of four line drawings; circle the one that is not in the set, say why
odd_one_out.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps

sort_groups.name: Sort into Groups
sort_groups.teaches: sorting objects by one attribute (kind, colour, size, shape) into labelled groups, then saying the sorting rule
sort_groups.representation: picture tiles and two or three labelled sorting rings; write the letter of each tile in its ring; option: rule given or rule found
sort_groups.why: existing WRM_PROPOSALS entry; covers these steps
